name: PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE_
description:
This table stores all information related to the person?s Work Relationships. An Work Relationship denotes a formal relationship between a person and a legal employer.  Therefore, this table will hold information for employees and contingent workers.

Current design allows for a person to have multiple active ?periods of service? as long as they are for different legal entities. This is not Effective Dated.

columns.name: DATE_EMPLOYEE_DATA_VERIFIED
columns.description: Date when the employee last verified the data.

columns.name: FAST_PATH_EMPLOYEE
columns.description: Accepts values of ?Yes?  or ?No?.

columns.name: LAST_WORKING_DATE
columns.description: Last Date Worked (for terminated workers).

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Represents Legal Entity.

columns.name: LEGISLATION_CODE
columns.description: Legislation code derived from Legal Entity.

columns.name: ON_MILITARY_SERVICE
columns.description: Accepts Yes or No values. If Yes, employee is also on military service.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DATE_OF_HIRE
columns.description: Original date of hire.

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Determines whether it is a period of service for an Employee, or Contingent worker: ?E? or ?C?, or ?N?: non-worker.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Accepts Yes or No values. If Yes, this employment period is considered the primary for the Legal Entity.

columns.name: REHIRE_AUTHORIZOR
columns.description: Obsolete

columns.name: REHIRE_REASON
columns.description: If rehire recommendation is ?yes?, then reason from recommending person is tracked via this field.

columns.name: REHIRE_RECOMMENDATION
columns.description: Accepts Yes or No values. If Yes, person is recommended for re-hiring.

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Uniquely identifies an employee or contingent worker. Can be system-generated or manually populated.

columns.name: ACTION_OCCURRENCE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to PER_ACTION_OCCURRENCES.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: This stores a comment associated with termination of work relationship.

columns.name: WORKER_COMMENTS
columns.description: This stores a worker comment associated with the Resignation Process.

columns.name: REHIRE_AUTHORIZER_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to PER_PERSONS. Represents the person who recommends the worker for rehire.

columns.name: REVOKE_USER_ACCESS
columns.description: This stores user?s option of revoking user access on Termination. Values accepted are ?I? for Immediately or ?A? for After termination

columns.name: READY_TO_CONVERT
columns.description: Column to use to convert pending worker to employee based on flag

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
